purpose: Rules for exchanging transient, per-process data between a calling SKILL and a custom Agent so that handoff does not break regardless of data size.
summary: Scope: only data that exists during one process, not permanent documents
Why prompt and return value must not carry full content: size, AI relay distortion, undefined shape
Carry only identifiers generated by scripts; AI never builds paths or identifiers
Scripts write data; AI passes values and never assembles JSON; publish once when complete
Readers get an absolute path from a script and read the file directly
Values arrive unchanged including newlines, quotes and non-ASCII
Field meaning lives in the SKILL.md or agent definition, not in the data
Finalize before writing, no overwrite; exit value string "0" marks success
No runtime format validation; absolute paths allowed; delete everything after processing
Each feature decides identifiers, location, fields, error values
tasks: Designing a SKILL that delegates work to a custom Agent
Writing a custom Agent definition that receives requests and returns results
Implementing a script that writes or reads request and result files
Defining exit values and error value sets for a feature
Reviewing handoff between SKILL and Agent for compliance
title: agent とのデータ受け渡し
